title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — November 25, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.2 (Peaked November 25, 2026 at 04:33 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 359 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Sunny's having an easy shift. ☀️

A broad coronal-hole-like region stands out on today’s otherwise quiet-looking Sun.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 335 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
